errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the chart as having grouped bars ("групирани"). The chart actually consists of horizontal stacked bars ("натрупани").

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос показва процентното разпределение на отговорите и е структурирана на четири групи според степента на уязвимост
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis is structured into four groups. The horizontal axis represents a continuous percentage scale (implicitly 0-100), while the bars themselves are segmented into four parts corresponding to the legend categories.

errors.text_span: Стойностите на оста варират от 0 до около 83, като деленията са през 20 единици.
errors.evidence: The description invents features for the horizontal axis that do not exist. The axis has no visible tick marks, labels, or a specified range. The value 83.6 is the largest single segment value, not the end of the axis, and the claim of tick marks every 20 units is a hallucination.

errors.text_span: докато най-ниските стойности са при "майки с деца до 14 г. възраст" с 3,9% за "изобщо не са уязвими"
errors.evidence: The description claims that 3.9% is among the lowest values ("най-ниските стойности"). This is incorrect, as there are several lower values in the chart, the lowest being 0.8% for the category "Продължително безработни".
The description repeats the error of calling the structure "grouping" ("групирането") instead of stacking ("натрупването").
